method.geometry: Actual decoded published Draco LOD1; production architectureMatrix using actual all-LOD bounds; double-sided visibility.
method.nearbyPrefilter: World transformed actual mesh bounding box intersects ray within 20 m before triangles.
method.riskThreshold: A hit more than 2.4 m from start is >2 m behind collision boundary; report as setback.
limitations: Single outward horizontal ray per sample; missing at 1.62 m signals collision readability risk, not proof the area is visually open at every height or angle.
Gate openings, deliberate vistas, roofs and low props can count as missing although a different view may communicate the boundary.
Only layout.placements art meshes are audited; decks, technical backing/closure surfaces, ground, lighting and particles are excluded.
Collision and floor polygons are unchanged; this does not prove reachable out-of-bounds or navigation defects.
Short raster step edges receive one midpoint each; use lengthWeighted for map comparisons rather than unweighted sample percentages.

lengthWeighted.notes: Each sample represents its segment length divided by sample count; midpoint quadrature, not continuous mesh coverage.
